Is a life without a SO enjoyable for you?

After a couple of decades of serial monogamy, I settled down to bachelorhood, and finally grew content.

I think it depends on the person. Some only do well when they have someone else in their lives. Others, like me, only do well when they don't. Much though I wanted to be in relationships, and was in a pretty steady stream of them, I was just never very good at it, and I caused entirely too much harm along the way to realizing that. Now I can just share the good with other people and keep the bad to myself, where it belongs.

It´s an incredible feeling if you find that one person you really love. Having him/her in your life will grade everything up and you would not want to be without them.

But it´s not important to try to enforce this. Life can be truly happy without them. The person I love left me and there is a very little chance of them coming back. But I´m on my way to start appreciating life again. Life´s not better without this person but it can be a fulfilled and happy one, too. Happiness should not depend on you SO. He/she should just be the cherry on the cake.

Studies have shown that at least for men you live a lot longer if you are married than if your remain a bachelor. I know personally having a SO motivates me to live a little bit healthier. Everyone's different, but in general I think most people are better off if they have someone else. If you have a very strong network of friends though that can certainly compensate, but the older you get the harder that is to maintain.

For me it's very important. I have a deep rooted desire to be accepted and loved, and the ultimate form of that is an exclusive romantic relationship. I can go without one, but I find life much more fulfilling and enjoyable with someone I can share it with in that way

Depends on what you want out of life.

I've known several folks over the years who were perfectly content to be alone... and others who accepted loveless marriages out of convenience or economic expedience. Then there are the folks who are genuinely in love. They occasionally have rough patches, but are there for each other in thick and thin. In envy them.

Do I miss intimacy (as in, utter trust) and sex (which I consider separate)? Of course! I want both very much. I limp by on the former with very close friends and every once in a (very long) while have a one night stand, but it's not the same. I want a partner, a lover, an intimate. I DO think it's important both for my sanity and my physical well-being. We are social creatures who are affected profoundly by our needs not being met fully.

Do I enjoy life without an SO? In some ways, no. In many other ways, very much yes. Life isn't JUST about love or marriage or fucking or dating. There's a large segment of our wants and needs that have to do with such things, but I find ways of filling the void that lies open until someone else helps me fill it.
